# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 previews the Skia m153 engine update with upstream rendering fixes. Linux font fallback can choose a different fontconfig face; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when selection must be deterministic.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback can select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the prior FcFontSort fallback path. Applications that depend on the exact fontconfig fallback face may see different glyphs or text metrics; specify an explicit family and style, or bundle the required typeface.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153 and includes the corresponding upstream rendering fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
